verdict.rationale: Gusto's Embedded Payroll API documents generating and retrieving a General Ledger report in JSON for a given payroll, so developers can view payroll-derived accounting data programmatically. There is no evidence of a broader dedicated accounting API for managing that data, and the Money Dashboard is a UI feature, not an API. Missing for 10: managing accounting data (e.g., account mappings, journal entries, sync controls), accounting coverage beyond per-payroll GL reports, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can view and manage accounting data through a dedicated API

citations.quote: When you create a General Ledger report and use the resulting request_uuid to retrieve the report, you'll see that the report is generated in a JSON format.
